scoreMethod: Per board, the model's best position p on the board's overall table of N rows gives 100 * (N - p) / (N - 1). A model on several boards for one task takes the mean, rounded half up. Rank orders the task's catalog models by the unrounded mean, then a newer version of a scored family sits directly above the best-ranked member of the version before it, then every other model, newest release first. Last, a newer version of a model line, one family and one variant, never ranks below an older version of that line: it takes the place of the highest-ranked older version, which moves down one with every model below it.
